details.flavorMarkdown: *A single cloudy eye dominates the face of a giant who carves fragments of dreams into roadside stones.*
details.specialtyMarkdown:
### Stone-brow axe

**Target:** One visible creature within 2 squares. **Player defense:** Agility. **Damage type:** physical.

**Weak defense:** Prone.

### Thrown stone

**Target:** One visible creature within 7 squares. **Player defense:** Agility. **Damage type:** physical.

**Limit:** Requires an available loose stone; picking it up is part of this attack. No stone means this attack is unavailable.

### Study the Opening

*It waits for a tell in the stance, then turns its attention to the exposed line.*

Its next attack before the end of this turn imposes 1 additional Bane on player defense, or gains 1 Boon when player-controlled. One attack only; no stacking with itself.

### Seen It Already

*It starts moving a heartbeat before the strike, following a future the attacker has not yet reached.*

Before one attack from a visible attacker against this creature is rolled, impose 1 Bane on that attack. Against an NPC attack, grant 1 Boon to its single defense roll instead. This changes no target or outcome after dice have been rolled; it does not cancel the action.
details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules; repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature; spend its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if capable.

**Heavy Frame — Passive:** Stability 2; an explicit trait, not a bonus calculated from Size.

**Healing:** Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

**Senses:** Ordinary sight and hearing.

**Tactics and retreat:** Study the opening before committing to the axe, or throw a stone when a narrow approach would surrender its reach advantage.

**Encounter and conversation:** The cyclops recognizes the party from a vision but has misunderstood which part of it was a warning.

**Habitat:** Highland; quarry; remote stronghold · **Communication:** Common and Giant

**Loot:** Recoverable possessions or lair clues chosen for the adventure; body parts grant no automatic special equipment or coin value.

**Summoning:** Ineligible.
details.designNotesMarkdown:
## Design notes — not needed during play

**ID:** creature-cyclops


**Category:** Giant · **Role:** Knockdown fighter · **CV:** 34

### Creature-roll reference

| Attack | Attribute | Attack modifier | Weak attack | Standard attack | Strong attack |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Stone-brow axe | Brawn | 1 Boon | 4 physical damage. | 7 physical damage. | 10 physical damage. Prone. |
| Thrown stone | Brawn | 1 Boon | 3 physical damage. | 5 physical damage. | 7 physical damage. |

Use the attributes above for defenses named by incoming attacks. Same targeting, limits and costs apply; no opposed second roll.

### CV worksheet

**Reference damage:** 4/7/10

**Reference type:** physical

**Expected targets:** 1

**Utility factor:** 1.4

**Action review (#1279):** U 1.3 → 1.4: Maneuver allowance +0, Reaction allowance +0.1. These are provisional judgments for the changed capabilities, counting the largest increment in each category rather than adding every alternative. Reactions compete for one budget; no measured balance claim.

**Regeneration per turn:** 0

Reference I=4.000, O=6.894. Uses the [seed worksheet](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/bestiary/encounters.md). Utility is provisional and does not simulate control, positioning or summon choices.

**Ability sources:** [knockdown strike](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/knockdown-strike.md), [Seen It Already](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/seen-it-already.md), [watch the opening](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/watch-the-opening.md).

**Coverage reference:** [Pathfinder family survey](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/bestiary/family-survey.md); original HOL prose and mechanics.

# Knockdown Strike

*The target’s footing gives way beneath the force of the blow.*

## Rules

**ID:** monster-knockdown-strike


**Action:** Main Action

Apply Prone only at the printed outcomes. Stability does not prevent Prone. Standing costs 2 squares of movement; no extra attack modifier is added.

Actual damage, targeting and defense attribute are printed on the creature card.
